name: terminal-per-file
description: Pin a dedicated terminal to each file and auto-switch to it when the active editor changes.

commands.title: Terminal Per File: Close Terminal For Current File

enumDescriptions: One dedicated terminal shared by all files in the same directory.
terminalPerFile.scope.description: Whether terminals are pinned per file or per directory.

terminalPerFile.useTmux.description: Back each file's terminal with a persistent tmux session instead of a plain VS Code terminal. The tmux server keeps running independently, so long-running processes survive closing the VS Code window and reattach automatically next time.

terminalPerFile.tmuxSessionPrefix.description: Prefix used when naming the tmux session for each file (only used when useTmux is enabled). Helps you tell these sessions apart in `tmux ls`.

terminalPerFile.tmuxBinary.description: Path to the tmux executable, if it's not on your PATH.
